title: Reach the Favàritx lighthouse at dusk
description: A black-and-white striped lighthouse on a headland of ribboned black slate that looks like nowhere else on the island, at the northern edge of the s'Albufera des Grau nature park. Car access is restricted in season — in 2026, from 15 May to 31 October — and you get there on the seasonal bus from Maó (route 43, around €3.65 each way); check the year's calendar before setting off. If you only see one lighthouse in Menorca, make it this one.
whenLabel: All year · car access regulated in season
imageAlt: Favàritx lighthouse, its black-and-white striped tower at the end of the path
